name: project_harmony_application_graph
description: Project authenticated HarmonyOS HAP, HSP, or App Pack inventory Evidence into an execution-free application inventory. Reports packaging-model hints (Stage module.json versus FA config.json), exact component paths and hashes (manifests, Ark bytecode, resources, native libraries, JavaScript, signing), authenticated files outside those categories in unclassified_components, App Pack child packages, runtime-family hints, and path-based N-API bridge hypotheses without decoding Ark bytecode, parsing manifest semantics, or claiming observed runtime calls.

parameters.description: Declared Evidence fields accept complete records or {"kind":"retained-evidence","evidence_id":"ev_..."}. For a complete source, use the summary's parent_evidence_id. Advertised in reduced form by the compact input schema profile; the server still validates complete canonical inputs.
